## Florida's Population and Growth, 2020–2050

Where Floridians live now, and where the state is expected to grow. Drag the slider across the map to compare each county's 2020 population (blue) with its projected growth from 2020 to 2050 (red). Click a county for details.

## Florida's Impaired Waters

Florida checks the health of its rivers, lakes, springs, estuaries, and coastal waters by dividing them into assessment units called waterbody IDs (WBIDs). Waters that fail state standards for things like nutrients, bacteria, or dissolved oxygen go on the **verified impaired list**, which means the state has to set a pollution limit for them. Click any waterbody to see its name and what it's listed for.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://js.arcgis.com/4.30/esri/themes/light/main.css">
<div class="viewer map live-map">
  <div id="impaired-map" role="region" aria-label="Map of Florida waterbodies showing which are on the state's verified impaired list"></div>
  <div class="map-status" id="impaired-status">Loading Florida DEP data…</div>
</div>
<script src="https://js.arcgis.com/4.30/"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var status = document.getElementById("impaired-status");
  var notes = [];
  function say(msg) { status.hidden = false; status.innerHTML = msg; }
  function fail(why) {
    notes.push(why); console.warn("[impaired-map]", why);
    say("The state's map data didn't load. <a href='https://geodata.dep.state.fl.us/datasets/FDEP::waterbody-ids-wbids/about'>View it on Florida DEP's site</a>.<br><small>Details: " + notes.join("; ") + "</small>");
  }
  window.addEventListener("error", function (e) { if (e && e.message) notes.push("script: " + e.message); });
  if (typeof require !== "function") { fail("the ArcGIS map library didn't load"); return; }
  setTimeout(function () { if (!status.hidden && /^Loading/.test(status.textContent)) fail("timed out after 60 seconds"); }, 60000);

  var DEP = "https://ca.dep.state.fl.us/arcgis/rest/services/OpenData/";
  var UF = "https://taurus.at.geoplan.ufl.edu/arcgis/rest/services/fgdl/FDEP_Water/MapServer";

  function getJSON(u) {
    return fetch(u + (u.indexOf("?") > -1 ? "&" : "?") + "f=json").then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json();
    }).then(function (j) { if (j.error) throw new Error(j.error.message || "service error"); return j; });
  }
  function firstLayer(svcUrl, re, not) {
    return getJSON(svcUrl).then(function (svc) {
      var hit = (svc.layers || []).filter(function (l) { return re.test(l.name) && !(not && not.test(l.name)) && !(l.subLayerIds && l.subLayerIds.length); })[0];
      if (!hit) throw new Error("no matching layer in " + svcUrl.split("/").slice(-2)[0]);
      return svcUrl + "/" + hit.id;
    });
  }
  function tryAll(cands, label) {
    var i = 0;
    function next(err) {
      if (err) notes.push(label + ": " + err.message);
      if (i >= cands.length) return Promise.reject(new Error(label + " unavailable"));
      return cands[i++]().catch(next);
    }
    return next();
  }

  require([
    "esri/Map", "esri/views/MapView", "esri/layers/FeatureLayer", "esri/layers/TileLayer", "esri/Basemap",
    "esri/widgets/Legend", "esri/widgets/Expand", "esri/widgets/Home"
  ], function (Map, MapView, FeatureLayer, TileLayer, Basemap, Legend, Expand, Home) {
    try {
      var view = new MapView({ container: "impaired-map",
        map: new Map({ basemap: new Basemap({ baseLayers: [new TileLayer({ url: "https://services.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer" })] }) }),
        center: [-83.6, 27.9], zoom: 6, constraints: { minZoom: 5 } });
      view.ui.add(new Home({ view: view }), "top-left");
      view.ui.add(new Expand({ view: view, expanded: window.innerWidth > 700, content: new Legend({ view: view }), expandTooltip: "Legend" }), "bottom-left");
    } catch (e) { fail("map setup: " + e.message); return; }

    function popup(title) {
      return { title: title, outFields: ["*"], content: function (f) {
        var a = f.graphic.attributes, rows = "";
        Object.keys(a).forEach(function (k) {
          if (/^(objectid|fid|shape|globalid|autoid)/i.test(k) || a[k] === null || a[k] === "") return;
          if (!/(wbid|name|param|class|type|cause|basin|group|cycle|county|status|category)/i.test(k)) return;
          rows += "<tr><th>" + k.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase() + "</th><td>" + a[k] + "</td></tr>";
        });
        return rows ? "<table class='esri-widget__table'>" + rows + "</table>" : "No details available.";
      }};
    }
    function addLayer(url, title, label, color, outline) {
      var lyr = new FeatureLayer({ url: url, title: title, outFields: ["*"], popupTemplate: popup(title),
        renderer: { type: "simple", label: label, symbol: { type: "simple-fill", color: color, outline: { color: outline, width: 0.5 } } } });
      view.map.add(lyr);
      return lyr.load().then(function () { console.info("[impaired-map] loaded", title, url); return lyr; });
    }

    var wbidUrl = tryAll([
      function () { return getJSON(DEP + "WBIDS/MapServer/0").then(function () { return DEP + "WBIDS/MapServer/0"; }); },
      function () { return firstLayer(UF, /(wbid|waterbody id)/i, /verified|delist|impaired/i); }
    ], "waterbodies");
    var verUrl = tryAll([
      function () { return firstLayer(DEP + "IMPAIRED_WATERS/MapServer", /verified/i, /delist/i); },
      function () { return getJSON(UF + "/8").then(function () { return UF + "/8"; }); }
    ], "impaired list");

    var good = 0;
    var p1 = wbidUrl.then(function (u) { return addLayer(u, "Waterbodies (WBIDs)", "Not on the verified impaired list", [31,127,153,0.28], [31,127,153,0.7]); })
      .then(function () { good++; }, function (e) { notes.push("waterbodies: " + e.message); });
    var p2 = verUrl.then(function (u) { return addLayer(u, "Verified impaired", "Verified impaired (needs a pollution limit, or TMDL)", [200,102,31,0.6], [150,60,10,0.9]); })
      .then(function () { good++; }, function (e) { notes.push("impaired: " + e.message); });
    Promise.all([p1, p2]).then(function () {
      if (good === 2) status.hidden = true;
      else if (good === 1) { say("Part of the map loaded. <small>" + notes.join("; ") + "</small>"); setTimeout(function () { status.hidden = true; }, 8000); }
      else fail("no layers loaded");
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="map-key"><span class="k-imp">Verified impaired</span><span class="k-ok">Not on the verified impaired list</span></div>
<p class="map-credit">Data: Florida Department of Environmental Protection, Waterbody IDs and Verified List of Impaired Waters, loaded live from DEP's map server. Waters not on the verified list aren't necessarily healthy. Some have too little data to assess, and others are impaired but already have a pollution limit in place.</p>
```
